# GitHub Copilot Instructions

The canonical Copilot instructions for this project are maintained in:

**`.github/copilot-instructions.md`** (repository root)

That file is the single source of truth for:
- MCP tools available
- Project overview and tech stack
- Key conventions (file organization, TypeScript, agent system, providers)
- Skills system
- Testing guidelines (Vitest for unit tests, Playwright for E2E)
- CI/CD workflows
- Security guidelines
- Do NOT rules

Please refer to `.github/copilot-instructions.md` for all guidance.
